label: Weddings
seoTitle: Live Wedding Music in Los Angeles | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Ceremony, cocktail hour and reception music from Sean Carney, solo or with his band The Hustlers. Fifteen years of weddings across Los Angeles and abroad.
headline: Ceremony to last dance
intro: Fifteen years of weddings in Los Angeles and around the world. Sean performs solo, as a duo or trio, or with his full band, The Hustlers, and shapes every set around the two of you.
imageAlt: Sean Carney in a black suit and hat, playing acoustic guitar in the canyons

items.title: Ceremony
items.body: Acoustic arrangements for the processional, the vows and the recessional, including a custom aisle song.

items.title: Cocktail hour
items.body: Sinatra and modern standards while guests find their drinks and each other.

items.title: Dinner
items.body: Warm, conversational sets that let the room breathe.

items.title: First dance
items.body: Your song, arranged for the moment. Many couples ask for an acoustic version of a track they love.

items.title: Reception
items.body: The Hustlers take the floor, and keep it full.

blocks.caption: A first dance under string lights, live.

blocks.title: Most requested
blocks.note: Frank Sinatra and modern standards for the cocktail hour. Full set lists, and your own requests, on request.
solo: Can't Help Falling in Love, Elvis Presley

items: Ceremony sound can run separately from the reception

label: Corporate and brand
seoTitle: Corporate Event and Brand Activation Music | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Live music for corporate events, launches and brand activations from an artist heard on the Olympics, the NFL Playoffs and national campaigns.
headline: For companies that care how the room feels
intro: An artist whose songs have run in national campaigns and on network sports, who arrives briefed, on time and fluent in run-of-show.
imageAlt: Sean Carney playing acoustic guitar on a corporate event stage with LED screens

blocks.title: Booked by
blocks.story: His music has scored the 2024 Paris Olympics, the 2025 NFL Playoffs and campaigns for Hyundai and WeightWatchers. For a launch or activation, that is a story your audience already knows how to tell.

blocks.title: Where he fits in the program

items.title: Launches and activations

items.title: Holiday parties and incentives
items.body: From a solo acoustic reception to a full band on the dance floor.

label: Private and estate
seoTitle: Private Party and Estate Event Musician | Sean Carney
seoDescription: Discreet, volume-aware live music for private estates, milestone celebrations and intimate dinners across Los Angeles, Malibu, Montecito and beyond.
headline: Private rooms, handled privately
intro: Milestone birthdays, anniversaries and dinners at home. Sean reads a room quickly and keeps the volume where conversation lives.
imageAlt: Sean Carney laughing in a suit and hat, holding an acoustic guitar outdoors

blocks.title: Discretion is the default.
blocks.body: Nothing is photographed, posted or mentioned without your permission. NDAs are welcome, and house managers and security teams are looped in from the first call.

items.title: Dinners and salons
items.body: Solo acoustic sets sized for a living room or a garden table.

items.title: Milestones
items.body: Birthdays and anniversaries with the songs that belong to the people in the room.

items.title: After dinner
items.body: When the night turns, the band can turn with it.
